Title: LSJ: Guruhi are the land + Vast wealth

Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:
Iniko has 3 vast wealths on him. he takes the VW action, uses GatL to
untap. Can he take another VW action, as he has more than one VW, or
is this limited by NRA?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


He cannot use the same VW this turn, but he can use one of the other ones.

Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:


"A minion cannot perform an action with the same action card or via
the same card in play (including from the minion's own card text) more
than once each turn, even if he untaps."

So, what is stopping a vampire from using different Govern the
Unaligned at DOM 3 or for times during a turn after Freak Driving
after each one?

It's not the "same action card" since the previous ones are all in the
ash heap. What's the difference between a card in play and a card
played with respect to NRA as above?

Jeff

Messages.Author: witness1
Messages.Body:


"Same action card" means an action card with the same name. "Same card
in play" means a particular copy of the card. The rulebook could be
clearer about this.

witness1
-believe the lie
